## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Also include relevant motivation, context, and how to verify the behavior.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Provide instructions so we can reproduce.

- **Automated Tests**: Mention new tests added.
- **Manual Verification**: Specify any manual tests performed (e.g. checked HTML/PDF export, tested synchronization across two browser tabs, file linking).

### Checklist:

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or typescript compiler issues (`npm run build` succeeds)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`npm test` succeeds)
- [ ] I have checked code coverage and ensured it meets or exceeds the **95% coverage threshold** (`npm run coverage` succeeds)
